infra-alert-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Sustained increase in 5xx and tail latency for hosted text-gen endpoints in apac1 starting 09:02 UTC. Spike peaked 09:06. p95 latency rose from ~1.8s -> ~4.3s. Traffic skewing to small dedicated pools and causing backpressure.
Eve (SRE): Picking this up. paging @Ben (Runtime) @Carla (Product). I’m going to gather impact and start mitigation. status: investigating
Ben (Runtime): On it. seeing large bursts of long sequences from a handful of tenants + sudden model switch to a high-cost variant. looks like batching backpressure and KV-cache thrash. quick log sample: 
```
2026-02-22T09:03:12Z request_id=abcd123 model=redwood-large-16k seq_len=2048 tokens=1785 backend_latency_ms=4200
```
Carla (Product): Any idea which customers are hot? SLA customers in apac1?
Eve (SRE): Quick look: two mid-market customers (cust-eta, cust-lynx) are responsible for ~40% of the burst. no enterprise SLA on those specific routes. plan: steer non-SLA traffic to an economy lane and apply a temporary soft cap to TierC.
Alex (Oncall): Recommend temporary "economy-lane dampening": reduce allocation for TierC routes, set regional steer away from apac1 to us-west for non-SLA, and apply a 25 rps soft cap on TierC. Also consider disabling tool-calling on TierC to reduce model runtime.
Ben (Runtime): I'll push a routing action now. running CLI: 
`redwoodctl routing update --policy economy-dampening --set "tierC_rate_limit=25" --set "regional_steer=us-west" --match "customer.sla==false && region==apac1"`
Ben (Runtime): applying changes... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: deployment started for policy economy-dampening v2 -> rolling to routers
deploy-bot: deployment success on 7/8 routers, 1 failing (retrying)
Eve (SRE): Also disabling tool-calling on TierC in apac1 to reduce timeouts: 
`redwoodctl features disable --scope tierC --feature tool-calling --region apac1`
Carla (Product): Drafting a short customer-facing blurb for affected users: "We're seeing increased latency in APAC. Non-SLA traffic may be temporarily routed to an economy lane to preserve overall availability. We're monitoring and will update when normal routing resumes."
Eve (SRE): Updating incident INC-2026-137 and status page. Estimated impact window: 1-2 hours while traffic cools.
Ben (Runtime): Retry on failed router succeeded. Routing telemetry shows p95 for TierC dropped from 4.3s -> 1.1s within 3 minutes after change. 5xx down ~70%.
Eve (SRE): Good improvement. Keeping dampening in place for 30m observation. If stable, we'll keep until peak ends then roll back gradually.
Carla (Product): Support notified to expect inbound from customers; prepping FAQ.
Alex (Oncall): Handoff to night team at 12:00 UTC. Eve/Ben please add runbook notes and sticky context in routing console (include causation, commands used, and auto-revert TTL).
Eve (SRE): Added runbook notes. Policy TTL auto-revert set to 2026-02-22T13:00:00Z unless extended. :white_check_mark:
Ben (Runtime): Follow-up item: add throttling condition for seq_len > 1024 to avoid similar bursts; filing RT-504.
Carla (Product): Also evaluating recommending quantized/low-cost variants as the default for certain high-QPS customers.
Alex (Oncall): Closing active paging loop; monitoring channel pinned. If regressions, page oncall again.
infra-alert-bot: :white_check_mark: MITIGATION APPLIED: economy-dampening v2 active. incident state: mitigated (monitoring).
Eve (SRE): Final check before I hand off: p95=1.0s, 5xx back to baseline. moving to 'watch' — will update if anything changes.
